scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.demo:seed: cd backend && cross-env CNA_DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./demo.db CNA_DEFAULT_CORPUS=none .\venv\Scripts\python -m app.ingestion.load_demo_case
scripts.dev:demo: npm run demo:seed && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:demo:backend" "npm run dev:demo:frontend"
scripts.dev:demo:backend: cd backend && cross-env CNA_DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./demo.db CNA_DEFAULT_CORPUS=none .\venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8001
scripts.dev:demo:frontend: cd frontend-next && cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8001 npm run dev:demo
